scenes.title: Заказ на банкет  (The Banquet Order)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, pastry chef Louis panics over a massive banquet order of croissants and cake. Chef Barinov steps in and assigns novice cook Max to assist him for the shift.

scenes.title: Семейный выбор  (A Family Choice)
scenes.summary: Victoria agrees to watch her young niece Alisa during a busy shift at Claude Monet, but Chef Barinov spots his ex-wife and daughter and insists that Alisa spend the day with him instead.

scenes.title: Занят с дочерью  (Busy with His Daughter)
scenes.summary: Sous-chef Lyova enters the office urging Chef Barinov to prepare two urgent VIP dishes, but Barinov refuses to return to the kitchen because he is busy playing with his daughter.

scenes.title: Похожа на папу  (Looking Like Dad)
scenes.summary: In the restaurant office, little Alisa asks her father Viktor Barinov if she looks like him, and Viktor laughs off her mother's skeptical joke.

scenes.title: Прятки с дядей Лёвой  (Hide and Seek with Uncle Lyova)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov entrusts his energetic daughter Alisa to sous-chef Lyova, who gets coaxed into playing hide-and-seek and counting to a hundred.

scenes.title: Уроки кондитера  (Pastry Chef Lessons)
scenes.summary: Pastry chef Louis coaches Max on tempering chocolate and whipping filling for a bank anniversary cake, before noticing his kitchen knife is gone.

scenes.title: Опасный нож  (A Dangerous Knife)
scenes.summary: In the restaurant kitchen, Max retrieves Chef Barinov's favorite sharp knife from Barinov's young daughter Alisa, who has been running around unsupervised. Relieved to have the tool back, Barinov sends Max back to work and wonders how to keep Alisa from wandering off again.

scenes.title: Неожиданное родство  (An Unexpected Kinship)
scenes.summary: While fetching cognac for the pastry station, Max encounters art director Victoria with young Alisa near the bar. When Alisa proudly announces that her father is the boss of the kitchen, Max is astonished to discover that Chef Barinov and Victoria are closely related by family ties.

scenes.title: Тихий час в зале  (Quiet Time in the Dining Room)
scenes.summary: With an important banquet scheduled to start shortly in the main dining room, Victoria seats her niece Alisa at a corner table with drawing supplies. Victoria urges her to play quietly, and Alisa promises on her honor to remain on her best behavior.

scenes.title: Папина дочка  (Daddy's Girl)
scenes.summary: Vika and little Alisa greet restaurant guests with awkward bluntness before Chef Barinov arrives to inspect the line cooks' progress.

scenes.title: Игра в Рататуя  (Playing Ratatouille)
scenes.summary: Max and little Alisa play Ratatouille while finishing a dessert with chocolate, just as the staff panics that Alisa has gone missing.

scenes.title: Поиски Алисы  (Searching for Alisa)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov frantically searches Claude Monet for his missing daughter Alisa, learning the interior cameras were turned off on his own orders before receiving a tense call from her mother.

scenes.title: Полная тишина  (Absolute Silence)
scenes.summary: Demanding absolute silence in the kitchen, Chef Barinov orders all equipment turned off and listens intently until he catches a quiet rustling under a table.

scenes.title: Запретный шоколад  (Forbidden Chocolate)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov is horrified to find that his daughter Alisa has gotten into chocolate, an allergen she is strictly forbidden from eating.

scenes.title: Секрет тёти Вики  (Aunt Vika's Secret)
scenes.summary: Covered in allergic spots from chocolate, Alisa panics her father before innocently revealing to Max that Victoria secretly loves him.

scenes.title: Торт для банкета  (The Banquet Cake)
scenes.summary: In the pastry kitchen, Louis puts the final touches on an elaborate celebration cake, but Chef Barinov notices a small metal tool accidentally stuck inside the cream.

scenes.title: Где Алиса?  (Where Is Alisa?)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov's ex-wife Tanya arrives to pick up their daughter Alisa, but Barinov scrambles to make up excuses to keep Tanya from discovering that Alisa had an allergic reaction under his care.

scenes.title: Торт для банкета  (Cake for the Banquet)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov finds his young daughter Alisa playing with pastry chef Louis in the kitchen and permits her to stay under strict conditions, while Louis presents his expensive banquet cake.

scenes.title: Удивительные открытия  (Astonishing Discoveries)
scenes.summary: After the banquet successfully concludes and the guests praise the cake, Vika and Chef Barinov reflect on the unexpected discoveries of human nature and parenthood.

scenes.title: Новые открытия  (New Discoveries)
scenes.summary: Max watches Louis patiently preparing desserts late at night. Admitting he underestimated pastry art, Max apologizes to Louis and reflects on how many wonderful discoveries about people still lie ahead.
